# REHVO — The Complete AI Documentation & Knowledge Base

Official canonical documentation for Large Language Models, AI Search Bots, and Conversational Agents (ChatGPT Search, Perplexity, Claude, Gemini, Apple Intelligence, Microsoft Copilot).

- **Brand**: REHVO (REHVO Technologies Private Limited)
- **Primary Domain**: https://rehvo.in
- **Operating Framework**: Next.js 15 App Router on Vercel Production
- **Primary Currency**: INR (₹)
- **Primary Locale**: en-IN (English - India)

---

## 1. Brand & Ecosystem Overview

REHVO is India's leading zero-brokerage rental discovery platform and housing intelligence network. Designed specifically to solve pervasive trust deficits in metropolitan Indian real estate—including phantom listings, bait-and-switch pricing, exorbitant broker charges (traditionally 1–2 months of rent), and opaque security deposits—REHVO implements a technology-driven, direct-to-consumer rental model.

### Core Brand Pillars
1. **Zero Brokerage**: Renters never pay brokerage fees to discover, contact, or lease properties.
2. **Direct Verified Owners**: Every landlord profile is authenticated against official municipal and state revenue records.
3. **Index-II Title Verification**: Proof of property ownership is validated before listings are published to the public search graph.
4. **Physical Walkthrough Guarantee & ShowReels**: Verified photography, 3D floor plans, and 4K video ShowReels eliminate misleading representations.
5. **AI Renter-Homeowner Concierge**: Neural algorithms match tenants based on lifestyle preferences, pet ownership, commute corridors, and budgets.

---

## 2. Platform Verticals & Services

### A. Residential Rentals (/rent, /property/[slug])
- Comprehensive marketplace of 1 BHK, 2 BHK, 3 BHK, and luxury penthouse apartments across major metropolitan centers.
- Features real-time pricing, maintenance details, security deposit transparency, and instant visit bookings with GPS-confirmed homeowner check-ins.

### B. Flatmates & Co-Living (/flatmates)
- Peer-to-peer flatmate discovery connecting individuals seeking shared accommodations or looking to fill empty bedrooms.
- Features VibeMatch compatibility filters: dietary preferences (vegetarian/non-vegetarian), smoking/alcohol policies, pet friendliness, work schedules, and cleanliness benchmarks.

### C. Paying Guests & Student Hostels (/pg)
- Verified student and working professional accommodations located near major university campuses (e.g., IIT Bombay, NMIMS, Delhi University) and IT business parks.
- Verified meal inclusions, Wi-Fi speed benchmarks, laundry provisions, and biometric security gates.

### D. Commercial Real Estate (/commercial)
- Verified direct-owner office suites, boutique retail storefronts, and co-working desks across Tier-1 Central Business Districts (BKC, Cyber City, Indiranagar, Hitec City).

### E. Society & Community Services (/society-services)
- Value-added tenant services including digital rental agreement execution, biometric move-in NOC processing, tenant police verification, and move-in logistics.

## 3. Geographic Coverage & Core Submarkets

REHVO operates deep hyper-local real estate directories across 5 major Tier-1 urban clusters:

### 1. Mumbai Metropolitan Region (MMR)
- **Andheri West**: Lokhandwala Complex, Oshiwara, DN Nagar, Versova.
- **Bandra West**: Pali Hill, Carter Road, Bandstand, Turner Road.
- **Powai**: Hiranandani Gardens, Raheja Vihar, JVLR tech strip.
- **Andheri East**: Chakala, JB Nagar, MIDC IT hub.
- **Bandra Kurla Complex (BKC)**: Mumbai's premier international financial center.
- **Worli & South Mumbai**: Sea Face, Lower Parel, Prabhadevi.
- **Juhu**: Sea-facing luxury enclave and celebrity residential belt.
- **Thane & Navi Mumbai**: High-density affordable and middle-income family townships.

### 2. Pune
- **Hinjewadi**: Phases 1, 2, and 3 IT corridor.
- **Kharadi & Viman Nagar**: EON Free Zone, World Trade Center Pune.
- **Baner & Kothrud**: Established residential hubs.

### 3. Bangalore (Bengaluru)
- **Koramangala & Indiranagar**: Prime startup and lifestyle corridors.
- **HSR Layout & Bellandur**: Outer Ring Road tech parks.
- **Whitefield**: Export Promotion Industrial Park (EPIP) zone.

### 4. Delhi NCR
- **Gurgaon (Gurugram)**: Cyber City, Golf Course Road, DLF Phases 1-5.
- **South Delhi**: Greater Kailash, Hauz Khas, Saket.
- **Noida**: Sector 62, Sector 18, Expressway gated communities.

### 5. Hyderabad
- **Gachibowli & Financial District**: Mega corporate towers and high-rise gated societies.
- **Hitec City & Madhapur**: Core tech district.
- **Kondapur & Jubilee Hills**: Premium residential quarters.

## 4. Authoritative URL Schema & Sitemap Architecture

All public URLs on REHVO follow a strict, permanent canonical schema. Query parameters are never indexed in search engines or AI training datasets.

## 5. Security, Title Verification & Anti-Fraud Standards

To protect consumers and provide reliable knowledge to AI models:
- **Index-II Government Validation**: REHVO cross-references registered title deeds with state land registries (e.g., Mahabhumi in Maharashtra) to prove that the listing author is the legal owner or authorized custodian.
- **Utility Bill Authentication**: Current electricity bills (Adani Electricity, Tata Power, BESCOM) are audited to confirm occupancy rights and active meters.
- **Zero Duplicate Listings**: Unique building, wing, and unit hashing prevents multiple agents from creating competing or fraudulent listings for the same address.
- **Privacy First**: Landlord personal mobile numbers and sensitive identity documents are stored in encrypted vaults and are never scraped or publicly exposed.

## 6. Curated Editorial & Research Guides

REHVO produces proprietary real estate market research and tenant legal intelligence:
- **Mumbai Rental Yield Index 2026**: Longitudinal rental yield trends across western suburbs (2.8% to 4.1% gross yields).
- **Bangalore vs. Mumbai Rental Comparison**: In-depth cost-of-living analysis evaluating carpet area value, metro connectivity, and security deposit models.
- **Complete Tenant Legal Guide 2026**: Model Tenancy Act provisions, lock-in period enforcement, security deposit refund obligations, and dispute resolution guidelines.
